newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA URGES EU TO LIFT VISA RESTRICTIONS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA URGES EU TO LIFT VISA RESTRICTIONS.

text.p: Bulgaria on Friday praised the European Court's decision to annul the European Union regulation on visa requirements for non-member states and said it expected visa restrictions for its citizens to be lifted.
"The court's ruling is only the first step towards abolishing visa requirements for Bulgarians," Foreign Minister Nadezhda Mihailova told reporters.
"But lifting the restrictions would depend on government's actions towards stabilising the country's economy and its efforts in combatting crime," Mihailova said.

The European Court of Justice annulled on Tuesday the Council of the European Union's regulation on visa requirements for third party nationals entering the EU, saying it had been adopted in violation of the EU legislative process.
The regulation is to stay in effect until the Council takes the necessary steps to clear the legislation with the European Parliament, the court ruled.
Mihailova said she hoped that Bulgaria, which is on the EU's Schengen list of countries with restrictive access to the EU member states, would be removed from the list.
